_provenance: Per-(execution block, window) barycentric velocity correction, in km/s, keyed on "<eb>|<lower window edge in GHz to 6 dp>".  Measured on the host during the round-8 line/baseline campaign by evaluating the observatory-to-barycentre projection for each block's own pointing and mid-time; it cannot be recomputed from the released catalogue, which carries no time stamps.  Frozen here as an input.  Source: referee_r8/work/bary.json, 2026-09-26.  Used ONLY to evaluate the stellar-frame column of the mask-width ladder; nothing the survey published depends on it, because the search ran topocentrically.
